title: Typewriter
description: The liner credits for the Beatles' Revolver on a typebar typewriter drawn flat and graphic. Every key swings its typebar into the ribbon and bites the cream bond with its own worn, uneven ink; Return throws the carriage home and rolls the platen.
intent: One machine reduced to clean flat shapes so the strike is the subject: real strikes on real paper, every letter landing a little differently, the carriage moving with weight.
